notes: Daily gage height, in feet; title says 1904-1912 but this page prints 1904-5, 1905-6 and days 1-5 of 1906-7, all one digitized table. Counted month by month. 1904-5: Oct 24 (from day 8), Nov 30, Dec 31, Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 26 (days 1, 27-29 blank), May 4 (days 3, 4, 7, 9), June 4 (days 27-30), July 31, Aug 31, Sept 30 = 301. 1905-6: complete, 365. 1906-7: 5 days x 12 months = 60. Total 726. Footnotes giving maximum recorded stages are not counted.
